mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not statistically positive (p>0.05) during 3 consecutive months of FEDFUNDS rising.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL inflation crossing above 3.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns negative despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 3.0% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly demand growth (GDPC1) outpaces monthly supply growth (INDPRO) by over 2 percentage points, this signals excess demand that drives equity price appreciation over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > INDPRO growth by >2% over 1 month
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.05 over 3-year window for GDPC1-INDPRO interaction vs individual proxies.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.0% strengthens equity valuations by reducing discount rates on future cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive when FEDFUNDS <3.0% in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL inflation for one month signals tight monetary policy, leading to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rising for 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not negative despite both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rising for 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate below 4.0% in an expansionary phase indicates strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive when UNRATE <4.0% for 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly demand growth (GDPC1) outpaces monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) by over 5 percentage points, this signals robust economic momentum that drives equity price increases over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > PAYEMS growth by >5% over 1 month
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over 2-year window for GDPC1-PAYEMS growth interaction vs individual proxies.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly demand growth (GDPC1) exceeding supply growth (INDPRO) by over 2 percentage points in an expansionary phase indicates market optimism, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > INDPRO growth by >2% over 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not positive when GDPC1 growth exceeds INDPRO by >2% over 1 month.
